story_type: spacewalk seen from a helmet camera
hook: Hanging off the space station, 250 miles above Earth.
narration: This astronaut is hanging off the space station, two hundred fifty miles above Earth.
July twenty twenty. NASA astronauts Bob Behnken and Chris Cassidy went outside together.
They wore small high definition cameras, so this is what they saw.
The station circles the planet about every ninety minutes, so a sunrise or a sunset comes about every forty five.
Every move is made by hand, with a safety tether clipped on so nobody drifts away.
[short pause] Below their boots, there is nothing but the planet.
It was the tenth spacewalk for each of them. Only two other American astronauts had ever done ten.
outcome: Behnken and Cassidy finished the spacewalk after five hours and twenty nine minutes outside.
title: Spacewalk camera, 250 miles above Earth
description:
Helmet camera views from NASA astronauts Bob Behnken and Chris Cassidy's spacewalk outside the International Space Station in July 2020, the tenth spacewalk for each of them. They concluded it after five hours and 29 minutes.
